prompt: You need an amide RC(=O)NR'₂. Starting from a carboxylic acid, what is the best route?

options.label: Convert COOH → acyl chloride (SOCl₂), then add amine (acyl chloride + 2 eq R₂NH)
Make the ester first, then displace OR with NR₂ (slow)
Mix COOH + amine, heat strongly (forms ammonium salt first; needs very high T)

explanation: Acyl chlorides react quickly with amines (one eq consumes product HCl); COOH + amine first forms a salt and needs harsh conditions.
